long_biography.plain_text:
Trained first as a ship's master and later in commerce, Erik Hays Thøgersen entered Danish business through Kommandor Rømø. The company was established in 1975 for shipping and related investments. Thøgersen became an owner and director, building a maritime platform that later included Hays shipping companies and offshore project development.

Kommandor Rømø now functions as both a marine holding company and an investment vehicle. Its subsidiaries span maritime services, offshore equipment, hotel operations and property on Rømø, while the parent also holds marketable securities. Thøgersen directly owns a majority stake and continues to manage the parent and several subsidiaries. Maritime remains the thread connecting his ownership and operating roles. Balance-sheet investments, subsidiaries, property and equipment remain corporate assets, not a measure of his personal wealth.

uncertainties.detail: Danish corporate filings use Erik Hays Thøgersen with ø, while Companies House transliterates the surname as Thogersen. The dossier preserves the authoritative record's valid UTF-8 Danish form and treats the ASCII spelling only as an identity variant.

Companies House confirms July 1938. An archival Danish source reports 1 July 1938, but no current primary record confirms the day, so 1 remains review-only. No reliable source establishes a specific birthplace.

Thøgersen's ownership and management are documented from the company's early history, but accessible official filings do not expressly name its legal founder or disclose initial financing. Self-made is therefore retained at high rather than very-high confidence, and Operator is used instead of Founder.

Maritime created the documented platform, but the parent now reports investments in subsidiaries, associates and marketable securities alongside offshore project development. Finance & Investments best describes the current parent-company value mix, while maritime remains material.

Thøgersen owns a majority stake in Kommandor Rømø, which in turn owns subsidiaries and securities. The parent's balance sheet, subsidiary property, ships, equipment and investment values belong to those companies and are not treated as Thøgersen's direct personal assets or net worth.

No exact personal LinkedIn, Instagram, Wikipedia, Forbes profile or personal website met the acceptance threshold. The hotel website belongs to a group subsidiary and is not proposed as a personal social profile.
Politics, controversies, allegations, legal matters, sanctions, irrelevant private-family detail, live wealth estimates and all private-vessel research were excluded.

review.notes: Identity, valid Danish spelling, July 1938 birth month and year, direct majority ownership and current operator roles are strongly supported. Review should accept Shipping & Maritime for wealth creation, Finance & Investments for current primary industry, Self-made at high confidence and Operator for relationship. The exact birth day remains review-only. Nothing has been compiled, approved or applied.
